issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Criminal Division, Fraud Section
title: 2026 Minnesota Medicaid and Benefits Fraud Takedown — Court Documents
supports: DOJ's public Minnesota court-document index, updated July 29, 2026, lists U.S. v. Fahima Mahamud with an Information as the available linked court document.
As retrieved on August 30, 2026, the index does not list a Mahamud plea agreement, change-of-plea minute, or judgment.
does_not_support: That Mahamud did not plead guilty; absence from this curated DOJ document index is not evidence that the reported July 9 plea did not occur.
That no primary plea record exists on PACER or another court system; this source establishes only the state of DOJ's public curated index as retrieved.
Any Feeding Our Future conviction ordinal.
notes: Use this source to document the provenance gap, not to negate contemporaneous court reporting. DOJ's separate July 29 case-summary page likewise continued to describe Mahamud at the charging stage.
